versions.changelog: Switch default image backend to Banana nano-nx and document SK login flow

- Initial release of the generate-image skill for the content factory pipeline.
- Supports generating article companion images, including header art, infographic cards, and inline visuals.
- Reads article drafts to extract topic, tone, and visual themes for image generation.
- Falls back to a local infographic renderer if external image generation fails.
- Exports PNG images to the content-production/ready directory for workflow integration.
